note: Time_stable: events acquired during a stable acquisition window (drift, fluid disturbances, channel-stability outliers excluded) — broad horizontal band on the CD1c (y) axis spanning the bulk of the time axis; the bright-CD1c upper band and start/end drift regions are excluded.
tips: Time stability gate. The Time x-axis excludes drift / fluid-disturbance regions at the start or end of the run (clogs, air bubbles, sample-end artifacts). The y-axis (Comp-APC-A, CD1c) serves: (1) channel-stability QC — a fluorescence channel plotted vs. time reveals time-localized drift (laser warmup, cytometer instability, sample evaporation); (2) vertical outlier exclusion — events that spike abnormally high (electronic noise) within an otherwise stable time window are removed by polygon. Any bright/stable fluorescence channel could serve the y-axis role; CD1c is used here for convenience.
